quests.title: Herbalist's Forage

dialogue.t: Ah yes, you must've seen my commission then. I'm happy someone has finally turned up to help.
So, how goes the search for those three Qingxin flowers? Have you got them yet?
Not bad, these Qingxin flowers will do just fine. Thanks a lot. Here, take these.
I'll get these Qingxin flowers delivered right away. We have patients depending on it to get better.

quests.description: Liyue Harbor’s Herbalist Gui needs three Qingxin.
